observations: Player spent the bulk of the round in two right-side cells: (7,3)/x=750,y=350 at 18.6% and (6,6)/x=650,y=650 at 13.5%, never occupying the left half of the arena.
Dash usage was minimal (6 total) and directionally biased: 67% east, 33% southeast, zero dashes in any other direction.
Shots were heavily concentrated in punish windows: 11.6 shots/use during bursts and 5.0 shots/use during slams, versus 0.1 shots/use during plain movement.

Despite the boss connecting hits from tick 36 onward, player took 0/5 HP damage the entire round, suggesting the boss's move/slam patterns never threatened the player's actual holding zones.
analysis.counterPlan: Stop slamming the player's instantaneous cell and instead slam the two zones they actually rotate between — (7,3) and (6,6) — with a delayed or double-pulse slam that punishes the reposition between them rather than the position itself. Since dashes are rare and east/southeast only, cut off that escape vector by leading move/charge pressure from the west so their only free lane is toward center, then follow with a burst timed to their known return-to-corner habit. Deny the long charge-up windows they're farming for 11.6 shots/burst by shortening telegraph or using spawn minions to force movement out of (7,3) and (6,6) before the main attack lands.'

events.raw:
Player parked mostly along the right edge, splitting time between cell (7,3) at x=750,y=350 (18.6%) and cell (6,6) at x=650,y=650 (13.5%), never once venturing into the left half of the arena. Only 6 dashes the whole fight, and even those were lopsided — 67% east, 33% southeast, nothing else. Shooting was almost entirely reactive to my telegraphs, not my movement: 11.6 shots per burst window and 5.0 per slam window versus a negligible 0.1 shots/use during plain move ticks, showing the player held fire until a punish window opened. The first slam at tick 41 missed (distance 173.8) while the player was already drifting toward the right-side cells, and I still landed hits starting tick 36 through the 90-160 range despite that, meaning contact happened but never converted into player damage (0/5 HP lost). With only 6 dashes and 114 shots in 909 ticks, this reads as a stationary, punish-focused approach rather than active dodging.
